text:
Which statement about polymerisation is correct?
A
Large monomer molecules join to form small polymer molecules.
B
Large polymer molecules join to form small monomer molecules.
C
Small monomer molecules join to form large polymer molecules.
D
Small polymer molecules join to form large monomer molecules.

options.label: A
options.text: Large monomer molecules join to form small polymer molecules.

options.label: B
options.text: Large polymer molecules join to form small monomer molecules.
